image_description: A close-up shot of several green, elongated vegetables inside a clear glass bowl. The vegetables have a smooth skin with some longitudinal ridges or striations, resembling snake gourds or ridge gourds rather than standard smooth-skinned cucumbers. One vegetable on the right is cut, revealing a pale interior with a central cavity. There is a faint watermark text '100' visible in the center.
